description: Search cannabis brands sold in New York. Filter by name, product category (e.g. flower, vapes, edibles, pre-rolls), brand type (local / national / mso), New York origin, microbusiness licensees, grow method (indoor / outdoor / mixed-light / combination — from OCM cultivator licenses; "sun-grown" and "greenhouse" accepted as aliases), ownership certification (woman-owned, veteran-owned, bipoc-owned, social-equity…), tag, or parent brand (the house that owns it — e.g. which brands PharmaCann or 1 Off run in NY). Rows include growType, licenseType, certifications, tags and how many dispensaries stock the brand.

grow_type.description: Cultivation method from OCM license data. sun-grown = outdoor; greenhouse = mixed-light or combination

microbusiness.description: Only brands holding a NY microbusiness license

ny_based.description: Only brands headquartered / grown in New York

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging: the result echoes `total` and `offset`, so request offset + limit for the next page

parent.description: Only brands owned by this parent brand / house (slug or name), e.g. "1-off", "PharmaCann", "GTI"

type.description: Brand type: local (NY), national, or multi-state operator

name: search_brands

growType.description: indoor | outdoor | mixed-light | combination (from OCM cultivator licenses)

parentBrand.description: Slug of the house brand that owns this one

dataUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of the feed this result came from: dispensary directory (OCM refresh), deals export, brand-availability export, or review index

source.description: Attribution line — CC BY 4.0, cite the row url

title: Search NY cannabis brands
